Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission questions

Julie — thanks for sending this over and for filling out the survey. Quick answers below; I pasted a short checklist and a minimal sample row for your engineering team.

On header tokens and subject token:
- Preferred: Use the portal (https://vendor.redwood.com) for first shipments. When you must email, include either a subject token or a custom SMTP header so our ingestion can auto-match.
- Subject token format we ingest reliably: [REDWOOD-PO:PO123456789] (square brackets optional). Please put that early in the Subject line.
- SMTP header we read: X-Redwood-PO: PO123456789
- Optional metadata header: X-Vendor-ID: ACME-1001 (helps with multi-entity accounts)

Minimal CSV row we accept (UTF-8, comma-delimited, header row required):
InvoiceNumber,InvoiceDate,Amount,Currency,PO,LineDescription
Example: INV-2027-004,2027-05-01,1250.00,USD,PO-987654,Consulting retainer

Checklist for email fallback:
- Subject contains REDWOOD-PO or X-Redwood-PO header present
- PDF(s) attached for line-item verification or CSV attached for direct parsing
- Billing contact + remit-to visible inside the PDF or CSV

I attached our vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (short form) — please complete Section B (billing remit-to and default PO mapping) and send back. I'll loop Karhtik for any edge cases on PO-stamping.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Vendor Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf)]

Adding a few procurement rules so Acme has them in one place:

- PO stamping: We only auto-apply payments if the PO on the invoice matches the PO on our system exactly (case-insensitive, hyphen normalization). If there are multiple POs per invoice, include a PO line per line item and include the summary PO in the invoice header.
- VAT / tax: If ACME sends VAT lines, include a separate column TaxAmount; otherwise we assume gross total.
- Remittance name: Must match the entity listed in your supplier profile or our payments ledger will flag for manual review.
- Exception SLA: If an invoice fails auto-ingest due to missing PO headers, it goes to a 72-hour procurement review queue — that delays payment.

Practical asks for Acme:
- When you send the CSV, please include a single example row and a small sample PDF (1 page) of the invoice you plan to attach. That helps our parser team validate alignments before go-live.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
